theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_tff_periodic_polynomial_constant
theorems.statement: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ) (c : ℂ), c ≠ 0 → p.comp (Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C c) = p → p = Polynomial.C (p.coeff 0)
theorems.natural_summary: If p has positive degree d+1, Taylor coefficients and the dth Hasse derivative show that translation invariance forces (d+1)·p.coeff(d+1)·c = 0. Characteristic zero, the nonzero leading coefficient and c ≠ 0 contradict this. Thus p has natural degree zero and equals C(p.coeff 0), also covering the zero polynomial.
